identification_rule: Inputs were identified by repository contents, package topology, modules, docs and progress records; attachment filenames were not used as authority.

inputs.content_identity: Four-package Fount workspace: packages/fount, packages/fount_observe, packages/fount_intelligence and packages/fount_workshop, with Phase-9 Workshop Intelligence integration and handoff/QC state.
System One poncho workspace containing system_one_contracts, system_one_sdk, system_one_bumblebee and system_one_server.
Provider-neutral Inference workspace under apps/inference with adapters including ASM.
ASM repository with lib/asm session, run, provider backend, provider-feature and inference-endpoint boundaries.
Fount implementation docset documents 00–36 plus handoffs through Phase 9; PROGRESS.md marks Phases 1–9 COMPLETE and Phase 10 first NOT_STARTED.

progress_authority.name: Durable Analysis Persistence, Reuse, and Recomputation

phase_boundary_notes: Phase 10 adds no direct SystemOneSDK, Inference or ASM calls. System One remains behind Observe; Inference remains Workshop generation infrastructure; ASM remains behind Inference.
Existing Observe cache identity/model-stability contracts and existing pure Intelligence recomputation APIs are reused rather than replaced.
